title_match_labels.primary_match: The job title matches one of your target roles
title_match_labels.primary_seniority: The seniority level matches your experience
title_match_labels.secondary_match: The job title matches one of your alternative roles

title_tier_labels_description: Display labels and help text for the preferred-role, alternative-role, and keyword fields.

title_tier_labels.target_roles_help: Preferred roles are the roles you want and are strongest in. These get the highest title-match score.
title_tier_labels.keep_target_roles_continue_error: Please keep at least one preferred role before continuing.
title_tier_labels.keep_target_roles_finish_error: Please keep at least one preferred role before finishing setup.
title_tier_labels.also_consider_roles_help: Alternative roles are roles you can do but are not your main focus. These still match but score lower.
title_tier_labels.role_search_help: Job Hunter searches each preferred and alternative role separately on each enabled job board. Results are combined, and confirmed duplicate jobs are kept once.
title_tier_labels.explore_adjacent_roles_help: Let unfamiliar but plausible titles reach description review. Turn this off to keep title matching strict.

signal_registry_labels_description: Display labels, help text, examples, warnings, and requirement-type review copy for the Signals inbox.

signal_registry_labels.category_capability_description: Skills, tools, methods, or domain concepts used for fit scoring. Approved capabilities help match job requirements to candidate profiles.
signal_registry_labels.category_cv_farming_description: Wording that suggests recruiter spam, resume harvesting, fake/pipeline jobs, or low-trust ads. These phrases indicate the role may not be a real hire.
signal_registry_labels.category_cv_farming_warning: ⚠️ Approving CV farming patterns will cause matching jobs to be rejected.
signal_registry_labels.category_hard_blocker_description: Strong rejection patterns that disqualify a job. Hard blockers are required dealbreakers that block matching jobs from processing.
signal_registry_labels.category_hard_blocker_warning: ⚠️ DANGER: Wrong approvals here can reject valid jobs. Only approve if the phrase is an absolute required blocker.
signal_registry_labels.category_job_type_description: Employment structure and engagement terms. Helps normalize contract, permanent, casual, and part-time work arrangements.
signal_registry_labels.category_profile_section_description: CV section headings that route profile text to primary, secondary, or supplementary profile support tiers. The suggested bucket shows where the LLM classified the section.
signal_registry_labels.category_requirement_review_description: Teach Job Hunter how to treat the same requirement when it appears again. Choose the top-level requirement type first. When the type is Eligibility, also choose the specific eligibility subtype so clearances, work rights, licences and registrations keep their exact meaning.
category_requirement_review_examples: current registration required for this specialty
signal_registry_labels.requirement_type_required_error: Requirement classification is required; choose capability, eligibility, or qualification.
signal_registry_labels.requirement_type_invalid_error: Invalid requirement classification '{classification}'; choose capability, eligibility, or qualification.
signal_registry_labels.requirement_subtype_required_error: Eligibility subtype is required; choose the specific kind of eligibility.
signal_registry_labels.requirement_subtype_invalid_error: Invalid eligibility subtype '{subtype}'. Choose one of the available eligibility subtypes.

capability_ui_labels_description: Display labels and help text for capability review and editing screens.

capability_ui_labels.help_text: Capabilities are the proven work strengths the agent found in your CV that help it match you to the right jobs. The strength you choose changes how much each capability influences matching, so use Strong for your best evidence and Basic for thinner or older evidence. Related Skills are synonyms, abbreviations, or tightly related sub-skills that belong under the same capability, helping the agent recognize them across different job ads. You can delete any incorrect matches.
capability_ui_labels.settings_empty_text: No capability rules yet. Run onboarding or add a capability row here.
capability_ui_labels.review_strength_prompt_label: How strong is this capability for you?

settings_clearances_labels_description: Display labels and help text for the Clearances rules editor.

settings_clearances_labels.help_text: Tell Job Hunter which Australian government clearance levels you hold. These are eligibility facts, not skills, and they are checked separately from your capability matrix. Leave a row as Not set if you do not want to record that clearance yet.
settings_clearances_labels.implied_state_label: Held automatically with a higher clearance
settings_clearances_labels.eligibility_add_error_message: Could not save this eligibility fact. Check your connection and try again.
settings_clearances_labels.eligibility_help_text: Add eligibility facts that are not managed clearances, such as citizenship, work rights, licences, permits, checks or professional registrations.
settings_clearances_labels.eligibility_name_placeholder: e.g. Australian citizenship, unrestricted work rights, AHPRA registration, working with children check
settings_clearances_labels.eligibility_empty_text: No generic eligibility facts added yet.
settings_clearances_labels.eligibility_prefill_added_message: Draft eligibility fact added: ${name}. Review it and save when ready.
settings_clearances_labels.eligibility_prefill_exists_message: This eligibility fact is already in your profile: ${name}.
settings_clearances_labels.qualification_add_error_message: Could not save this qualification. Check your connection and try again.
settings_clearances_labels.qualification_help_text: Add education, degrees, certifications, and formal qualifications as concise reusable profile concepts.
settings_clearances_labels.qualification_name_placeholder: e.g. CBAP, PRINCE2, Bachelor of Information Technology
settings_clearances_labels.qualification_prefill_added_message: Draft qualification added: ${name}. Review it and save when ready.
settings_clearances_labels.qualification_prefill_exists_message: This qualification is already in your profile: ${name}.
settings_clearances_labels.eligibility_group_help_text: Eligibility covers pass/fail entry gates such as clearances, citizenship, work rights, licences and registrations. Clearances stay managed separately inside this section because higher Australian government clearance levels imply lower levels.

role_history_labels_description: Display labels for the read-only captured role history panel in Settings.

role_history_labels.help_text: Read-only onboarding role history used when a job asks for explicit years or months in a role.
role_history_labels.empty_text: No role history captured yet. Upload your CV, then use Refresh from saved CV.

experience_requirement_labels_descriptio: Note shown on a job requirement that asks for explicit years/months in a role. The fit-review LLM names the matching saved role family; the numbers are looked up from captured role history.

experience_requirement_labels.duration_proven: Role history proves {months} months in {family} against {required} required months.
experience_requirement_labels.duration_gap: Role history shows {months} months in {family}, short of the {required} required months.
experience_requirement_labels.role_unresolved: Role history could not confirm a matching role family for this {years}-year requirement — needs review.
experience_requirement_labels.duration_only: This requirement asks for {years} years in a role.

shared_ui_labels_description: Shared labels for reusable app chrome and common action buttons.

shared_ui_labels.app_stage_title: Test mode is enabled for this session.
shared_ui_labels.account_menu_reset_user_warning_label: Warning: clears your profile, CV, review feedback, and history.
shared_ui_labels.app_footer_copyright_label: © 2025–2026 Roberto Hernan Voto. All rights reserved.

No permission is granted to copy, modify, distribute, sublicense, commercialise, or otherwise use this software or substantial portions of it without prior written permission from the copyright owner.
shared_ui_labels.location_help: Choose up to 3 states, territories, or capital cities. Sydney means a city search on SEEK and a city search with a 50-mile radius on LinkedIn. NSW means a state search on SEEK and LinkedIn. APS Jobs maps both Sydney and NSW to NSW.
shared_ui_labels.search_wait_copy: This search can take a while because Job Hunter checks multiple sources, opens the job details that matter, and scores each match before it appears here.
shared_ui_labels.search_wait_why_copy: We check multiple sources, open relevant job details, remove duplicates and rank the best matches for you. Some sites also require human-like pacing.
shared_ui_labels.search_running_copy: Job Hunter is checking sources and ranking matches. This process may take several minutes.
shared_ui_labels.search_starting_copy: Saving your settings and beginning the scrape.
shared_ui_labels.search_running_subcopy: Keep this tab open. The workspace will refresh when the run finishes.
shared_ui_labels.search_starting_subcopy: The workspace will refresh automatically while the search runs.
shared_ui_labels.search_stopping_copy: The current search was stopped on purpose. Job Hunter will keep the results collected so far.
shared_ui_labels.search_stopping_subcopy: This is an intentional stop, not a failure. Keep this tab open while the run wraps up.
shared_ui_labels.settings_privacy_copy: Job Hunter uses your uploaded CV to build the runtime profile used for matching. The raw CV is not the long-term source of truth, and packaged or shared builds must not include developer CVs, scraped jobs, logs, runtime databases, or private examples.
shared_ui_labels.settings_saved_no_effective_changes: No effective setting changes were detected.
shared_ui_labels.schedule_section_copy: These controls use your current search settings. Set the time here, then use the main Save Settings button. If the scheduler is already running, changes apply automatically without a restart.

access_status_labels_description: Managed copy for the Google account verification, access request, approval waitlist, and blocked-account pages.

access_status_labels.verified_copy: Your Google account has been verified.
access_status_labels.request_copy: Job Hunter is currently available to approved early testers. Request access to join the approval queue.
access_status_labels.waitlist_copy: Your request is waiting for approval. Sign in again later to check whether access has been approved.
access_status_labels.denied_copy: This Google account cannot currently access Job Hunter.

onboarding_page_labels.page_title: Set Up Job Hunter | Job Hunter
onboarding_page_labels.workflow_step_1: You upload your more recent detailed CV.
onboarding_page_labels.workflow_step_2: We extract likely roles, skills, and a starter search direction from your CV, using up to the first 5 pages during setup.
onboarding_page_labels.workflow_step_3: You review the draft, set search basics, and confirm it before matching starts.
onboarding_page_labels.cv_drop_zone_empty_title: Drag & drop your CV here, or click to browse
onboarding_page_labels.cv_drop_zone_loaded_hint: Drop another file or click to replace
onboarding_page_labels.cv_upload_help: Upload the CV that best represents your real experience. Job Hunter will use it to build your starting profile.
onboarding_page_labels.privacy_intro: We keep onboarding data as small as possible.
onboarding_page_labels.privacy_upload_only: Upload only the CV content needed for job matching.
onboarding_page_labels.privacy_sensitive_intro: Avoid including sensitive personal identifiers such as:
onboarding_page_labels.privacy_footer: Your uploaded CV is not stored. We only extract temporary job-related information needed to match you with suitable roles.
onboarding_page_labels.guidance_title: What makes a good CV for setup?
onboarding_page_labels.guidance_include_recent_roles: Recent and older roles with dates
onboarding_page_labels.guidance_include_bullets: Bullet points describing what you did
onboarding_page_labels.guidance_include_skills: Skills, tools, domains, or platforms you actually used
onboarding_page_labels.guidance_avoid_marketing_cvs: One-page marketing CVs with very little detail
onboarding_page_labels.guidance_avoid_image_layouts: Image-heavy layouts where the text is hard to extract
onboarding_page_labels.guidance_avoid_missing_dates: CVs with missing dates or vague role names
onboarding_page_labels.guidance_avoid_mixed_directions: Multiple different target directions crammed into a short summary
onboarding_page_labels.guidance_note: Plain, detailed content beats pretty formatting. For the full optional checklist, see the User Guide.
onboarding_page_labels.experience_priority_help: Choose how much older experience should count when matching you to jobs.
onboarding_page_labels.sector_preference_help: Choose if you have a sector preference you want Job Hunter to favour.
onboarding_page_labels.work_type_help: Choose if you have an employment type preference you want Job Hunter to favour.
onboarding_page_labels.work_mode_help: Choose if you have a work mode preference you want Job Hunter to favour.
onboarding_page_labels.minimum_compensation_help: Set the lowest salary or rate you want Job Hunter to consider.
onboarding_page_labels.review_setup_copy: Review your draft profile and search direction before Job Hunter starts matching roles.
onboarding_page_labels.extraction_review_caution: This draft was built from your CV. Review and correct anything that looks off before continuing.

onboarding_flow_labels.refresh_profile_confirm_title: Refresh your profile using this CV?
onboarding_flow_labels.refresh_profile_confirm_body_1: This will re-extract your summaries, capability rules, and profile support tiers from the document.
onboarding_flow_labels.refresh_profile_confirm_body_2: Your custom Decision Weights, Salary Preferences, and Search Settings will be preserved.
onboarding_flow_labels.create_profile_ready_message: Your draft profile is ready. Review the role direction before you continue.
onboarding_flow_labels.create_profile_status_reading_pages: Reading the first {count} pages of your CV...
onboarding_flow_labels.review_capability_helper_copy: Review the capability groups extracted from your CV.
onboarding_flow_labels.continue_search_basics_error: Could not save onboarding search basics before continuing.
onboarding_flow_labels.profile_status_error: Could not check whether a saved profile exists.
onboarding_flow_labels.clean_search_confirm_body_1: This removes the current job results, workspace shortlist, run stats, and latest review output for the current user.
onboarding_flow_labels.clean_search_confirm_body_2: Your profile, onboarding setup, and saved preferences will be kept.
onboarding_flow_labels.reset_user_confirm_body_1: This clears the current profile, onboarding state, uploaded CV state, local review feedback, and job history.
onboarding_flow_labels.reset_user_confirm_body_2: Shared learned signals will be preserved.

duplicate_labels.help_text: This is the matching card in your workspace. Use it to compare details.

workspace_card_labels_description: Labels and tooltips for workspace job cards.

workspace_card_labels.posting_channel_agency_recruiter_tooltip: Posted via a recruitment agency or third-party recruiter.
workspace_card_labels.posting_channel_likely_recruiter_tooltip: Recruiter language detected in the description. This may be posted on behalf of an employer.
workspace_card_labels.posting_channel_unknown_tooltip: Couldn't determine whether this was posted by the employer directly or via a recruiter.
workspace_card_labels.job_requirements_empty_state: No requirements were extracted for this job.
workspace_card_labels.job_requirements_detail_hint: The small grey helper line under a requirement row shows the matched capability in normal mode. Debug mode also shows the exact ad wording used for the match.
workspace_card_labels.debug_only_tooltip: This role was filtered out in the normal workspace view, but stays visible in debug mode.
workspace_card_labels.hard_blocked_tooltip: This role hit a hard blocker and would normally be excluded.
workspace_card_labels.partial_support_risk_suffix: is only partially supported by your profile
workspace_card_labels.title_block_button_tooltip: Hide future roles whose titles contain exact phrases you choose before Job Hunter spends time reading the full ad.
workspace_card_labels.title_block_guidance_copy: Job Hunter checks this phrase against job titles before reading the full job description. If you block “payroll”, titles such as “Payroll Administrator” or “Business Analyst – Payroll” will be hidden. A job will not be hidden just because “payroll” appears in its description. Only add a phrase when you are comfortable excluding future titles that contain it.
workspace_card_labels.title_block_prompt_copy: Choose the part of this title that should make similar jobs disappear from future results.
workspace_card_labels.title_block_manual_help: Use words that appear in the job title. You can add more than one phrase separated by commas.
workspace_card_labels.title_block_example_copy: Example: “Administration Coordinator – Payroll” → block “payroll” if payroll roles are not relevant to you.
workspace_card_labels.apply_method_easy_apply_tooltip: Apply directly on the job board with one click.
workspace_card_labels.apply_method_quick_apply_tooltip: Apply directly on the job board without leaving the site.
workspace_card_labels.reposted_badge_tooltip: The employer's verified original posting date is older than LinkedIn's current listing date.
workspace_card_labels.applied_badge_tooltip: You already applied for this role.
workspace_card_labels.hidden_badge_tooltip: You hid this role for now.
workspace_card_labels.new_to_you_badge_tooltip: You have not opened this role from the workspace yet.
workspace_card_labels.stale_badge_tooltip: This role is older, but still saved for reference.
workspace_card_labels.archive_badge_tooltip: This role was saved from an earlier search and kept on your workspace.
workspace_card_labels.add_to_profile_action_title: Confirm this capability and add it to your profile
workspace_card_labels.add_to_eligibility_action_title: Add this eligibility fact to your profile
workspace_card_labels.add_to_qualification_action_title: Add this qualification to your profile
workspace_card_labels.posted_age_badge_tooltip_template: This ad appears to be at least ${days} days old.
workspace_card_labels.action_not_for_me_tooltip: Marks this role as not a fit and stores it as learning feedback
workspace_card_labels.action_hide_tooltip: Hide this one job only. You can unhide it later from Hidden jobs.
workspace_card_labels.custom_blocker_reason_no_match: That's not one of this job's required terms. Only terms this job actually lists can be saved here — tick one of the suggested required terms above instead.
workspace_card_labels.custom_blocker_reason_ambiguous: This matches more than one requirement for this job, so it can't be saved automatically.
workspace_card_labels.custom_blocker_reason_not_required_templ: This matches a requirement, but it's only ${importance}, not required.
workspace_card_labels.action_rejected_tooltip: You got a rejection for this one. Records it as a real outcome, not a guess.
workspace_card_labels.action_no_response_tooltip: Never heard back. Records it as a real outcome, not a guess.

workspace_page_labels_description: Labels for the main workspace page (results.html).

workspace_page_labels.potential_jobs_empty_state: No shortlist matches right now. Check your filters or broaden your search settings.
workspace_page_labels.results_helper_copy: Job sites often return broad results even when the search is correct. If a title clearly doesn't match what you want, you can block similar roles directly from the title. This helps remove repeated noise from future results.
workspace_page_labels.applied_jobs_copy: This area is for jobs where you have already sent your CV. They are tracked separately so they do not clutter the live shortlist.
workspace_page_labels.hidden_jobs_copy: This area keeps roles you have intentionally pushed out of sight for now.
workspace_page_labels.search_settings_helper: Shared search settings used across sources.
workspace_page_labels.workspace_status_helper: These counts describe the jobs currently in your workspace. They change when you open, save, apply, or hide a job.
workspace_page_labels.lifetime_llm_helper: Total recorded LLM usage since the cost ledger began.
workspace_page_labels.how_match_levels_work_copy: Job Hunter compares each job's requirements with evidence in your profile. Mandatory requirements and stronger evidence carry more weight. Missing, partial, or weak mandatory requirements lower the result, which is then grouped into the match level shown on the card. Location, posted date, viewed status, and Easy or Quick Apply help you review jobs, but they do not prove fit.
workspace_page_labels.rejection_panel_title: Why isn't this a fit for you?
workspace_page_labels.rejection_panel_copy: Choose required terms you do not want the app to accept again.
workspace_page_labels.rejection_how_this_works_body: If you save a term here, future jobs are filtered only when it looks required. To block any mention, use global description blockers in Settings.
workspace_page_labels.profile_gap_not_have_saved_template: Marked {fact} as not in your profile

run_summary_labels_description: Managed labels for terminal and saved scrape-run summaries.
global_settings_labels_description: Display labels and help text for the global settings admin panel.

global_settings_labels.card_highlight_copy: These are global workspace rendering controls. They change what appears on every card, not the candidate profile or scoring rules.
global_settings_labels.strong_capability_matches_help: Shown on workspace job cards only. Controls how many strong capability matches appear before the card runs out of space.
global_settings_labels.working_capability_matches_help: Shown on workspace job cards only. Controls how many working capability matches appear per card.
global_settings_labels.basic_capability_matches_help: Shown on workspace job cards only. Controls how many basic capability matches appear per card.
global_settings_labels.reviewed_capability_matches_help: Shown on workspace job cards only. Controls how many approved learning capabilities are displayed per card.
global_settings_labels.max_highlights_help: Shown on workspace job cards only. This is the total cap across all highlight categories on one card.
global_settings_labels.search_defaults_copy: These settings seed search behaviour for the whole app. They do not replace the live search fields in Search.
global_settings_labels.default_search_window_help: How many days back each run looks for new listings by default. Profile search settings override this per run. Valid range:
global_settings_labels.default_seek_pages_help: Default SEEK crawl cap. Valid range:
global_settings_labels.default_linkedin_age_window_help: Default LinkedIn freshness window in hours. Valid range:
global_settings_labels.default_linkedin_results_per_search_help: Default result budget for each LinkedIn search. Valid range:
global_settings_labels.sort_newest_first_help: When enabled, the workspace prefers fresher jobs in search results.
global_settings_labels.linkedin_easy_apply_help: Leave unset unless you want the LinkedIn default to force Easy Apply filtering.
global_settings_labels.runtime_defaults_copy: These shared defaults apply outside the candidate profile. They stay centrally managed for workspace rendering and scraper runtime settings.
global_settings_labels.default_country_suffix_help: Used when the workspace trims repeated location suffixes from display text.
global_settings_labels.playwright_viewport_width_help: Shared browser viewport width used by the source connector runtime.
global_settings_labels.playwright_viewport_height_help: Shared browser viewport height used by the source connector runtime.
global_settings_labels.playwright_selector_timeout_help: How long the scraper waits for selectors before failing a browser interaction.
global_settings_labels.session_max_age_days_help: How many days a login session lasts before the user must sign in again. Takes effect on next login.
global_settings_labels.search_limits_copy: These bounds control what the search defaults can be set to. They are global, shared limits.
global_settings_labels.search_window_help: Lowest and highest number of days the search window default can be set to. Prevents defaults being set outside a sensible range.
global_settings_labels.seek_pages_help: Allowed range for the SEEK page crawl cap default.
global_settings_labels.linkedin_age_window_help: Allowed range for how fresh LinkedIn listings must be (in hours).
global_settings_labels.linkedin_results_help: Allowed range for the LinkedIn result budget per search term.
global_settings_labels.salary_limits_copy: These caps control the largest salary values users can save in Search and Onboarding. They are managed globally so the UI and API stay aligned.
global_settings_labels.max_permanent_salary_help: Upper cap for annual salary inputs. Leave it high enough to cover any realistic target.
global_settings_labels.max_contract_daily_rate_help: Upper cap for daily rate inputs. Leave it high enough to cover any realistic target.
global_settings_labels.evidence_tier_weights_copy: These global weights control how much each profile tier contributes when profile support is scored.
global_settings_labels.preference_weights_copy: These weights shape the global fit score. They stay shared across profiles so scoring stays consistent.
global_settings_labels.history_retention_copy: These shared retention limits control when archive and hidden jobs are re-reviewed.
global_settings_labels.archive_stale_after_days_help: How long an archived job stays fresh before the workspace treats it as stale.
global_settings_labels.hidden_review_days_help: How long a hidden job stays hidden before it is eligible for another review.
global_settings_labels.repeated_listing_min_times_seen_help: How many times the same listing must be seen before the repeated-listing red flag triggers.
global_settings_labels.repeated_listing_min_span_days_help: Minimum number of days between first and last sighting before the repeated-listing red flag triggers.
global_settings_labels.multi_listing_red_flag_min_listings_help: How many separate listings from the same poster and title cluster are needed to trigger the multi-listing red flag.
global_settings_labels.multi_listing_red_flag_min_span_days_lab: Multi-listing red flag minimum span days
global_settings_labels.multi_listing_red_flag_min_span_days_hel: Minimum day span across that cluster before the multi-listing red flag triggers.
global_settings_labels.description_trust_copy: This controls when a description fallback is trusted enough to use as full text.
global_settings_labels.minimum_trusted_description_length_help: If the fallback text is shorter than this, the system will not treat it as a trusted full description.
global_settings_labels.cv_files_copy: These file types are accepted when you upload or rebuild a CV. Keep them here so the app stays centrally managed.
global_settings_labels.allowed_cv_file_suffixes_help: Read-only. One suffix per line, including the leading dot. Update this in the managed advanced settings source, not from the UI.
global_settings_labels.onboarding_defaults_copy: These defaults seed fresh onboarding runs. They belong here because they are global tuning, not a candidate profile.
global_settings_labels.onboarding_learning_help: These controls shape automatic CV extraction and capability learning. Persisted or user-confirmed Related Skills are kept separately from LLM prompt budgets.
global_settings_labels.extraction_lookback_years_help: How far back the CV parser looks for role history when it decides what is recent enough to matter.
global_settings_labels.title_extraction_min_months_help: Roles shorter than this are treated as too brief to count as a main title signal.
global_settings_labels.max_target_patterns_help: How many primary job-title patterns the onboarding extractor keeps.
global_settings_labels.max_secondary_patterns_help: How many fallback job-title patterns the onboarding extractor keeps.
global_settings_labels.cv_page_limit_help: Only the first N pages of each uploaded CV are read during onboarding. Longer files are truncated and flagged in the onboarding alert.
global_settings_labels.capability_alias_limit_help: Controls how many Related Skills the LLM is asked to generate per capability during automatic CV extraction. Persisted or user-confirmed Related Skills are never silently truncated by this setting. Separate LLM prompt-budget settings control how much profile context is sent to the model.
global_settings_labels.signal_cluster_min_alias_hits_help: The minimum number of alias matches a learned signal cluster must collect before it is kept.
global_settings_labels.signal_cluster_min_snippet_hits_help: The minimum number of separate snippets that need to mention the signal before it is kept.
global_settings_labels.signal_cluster_dense_snippet_alias_hits_: A dense mention threshold that can keep a signal even when the snippet count is lower.
global_settings_labels.llm_models_copy: These controls manage the shared model list and prompt budget settings used by the LLM runtime.
global_settings_labels.allowed_models_help: Keep one model id per line. The runtime selector uses this list directly.
global_settings_labels.maximum_llm_chars_help: How much job text the LLM path keeps when it builds cache keys and review prompts. The allowed range comes from global settings.
global_settings_labels.llm_temperature_help: Controls sampling randomness when a Job Hunter LLM call is not using active reasoning. 0 is the most deterministic; valid range is 0 to 2. Calls with reasoning above none use reasoning effort instead.
global_settings_labels.model_pricing_help: Managed pricing used for cost logging. Keep it as JSON keyed by model id with `input` and `output` rates.
global_settings_labels.prompt_settings_help: Tune the prompt budget fields below. Keep the values centrally managed so the runtime and UI stay aligned.
global_settings_labels.capability_presets_copy: These presets define how the shared capability strength options behave.
global_settings_labels.capability_presets_empty_help: Load Global settings to view the preset tables.
global_settings_labels.rejection_history_clear_help: Deletes the local rejection history and its extraction cache. The next sync will reprocess the Google Sheet and may incur significant LLM cost.
global_settings_labels.rejection_history_clear_confirm: Delete the imported rejection history and extraction cache? This cannot be undone locally. The next sync will reprocess the sheet and may incur LLM cost.
global_settings_labels.rejection_history_clear_success: Imported rejection history and extraction cache deleted.
global_settings_labels.runtime_maintenance_copy: Use these admin actions to clear transient runtime data without resetting the full app. These actions do not delete imported Rejection History.
global_settings_labels.clear_runtime_caches_help: Clears shared runtime cache files and the occupation-title lookup cache. It does not delete imported Rejection History or its extraction cache.
global_settings_labels.clear_current_user_search_state_help: Clears this user's saved job history, workspace results, applied jobs, hidden jobs, and current search-state records. It does not delete imported Rejection History.
global_settings_labels.user_access_copy: Pending access requests appear first. Approve or block testers, or return an approved account to pending. The configured administrator is always protected.
global_settings_labels.user_access_empty: No access requests or managed tester accounts yet.
global_settings_labels.user_access_pending_summary_one: 1 access request is waiting for approval.
global_settings_labels.user_access_pending_summary_many: {count} access requests are waiting for approval.
global_settings_labels.system_health_copy: Shows unresolved operational failures that may stop Job Hunter working correctly. Routine job-level uncertainty stays available as read-only technical diagnostics instead of becoming work for you.
global_settings_labels.system_health_diagnostics_copy: Read-only debugging evidence grouped by category and source. These records do not ask you to make a decision or teach Job Hunter anything.
global_settings_labels.system_health_acknowledged_status: Acknowledged. This occurrence is hidden; the problem will return here if it happens again.
global_settings_labels.system_health_scraper_validation_complet: Scraper validation completed. Inspect the incident and technical context before acknowledging it.
global_settings_labels.system_health_developer_investigation_he: Developer investigation is required. Inspect the technical context before acknowledging this occurrence.
global_settings_labels.system_health_scraper_investigation_help: Run scraper validation to check the current source configuration, then inspect the technical context.
global_settings_labels.system_health_action_error: Could not complete the system health action.

settings_alerts_labels_description: Display labels and helper copy for the Messaging settings section.

settings_alerts_labels.section_copy: Connect Telegram alerts. Admins can also choose the model used for fit decisions.
settings_alerts_labels.telegram_copy: Connect your bot, check the connection, and send yourself a test message.
settings_alerts_labels.telegram_enabled_help: Turn this on to let Job Hunter send alerts through your bot. No restart is needed after saving.
settings_alerts_labels.telegram_bot_token_help: Paste the BotFather token for your bot.
settings_alerts_labels.telegram_bot_username_help: Used for the Connect with Telegram button. Leave off the @ symbol.
settings_alerts_labels.telegram_disable_link_preview_help: When on, Telegram sends workspace links without a preview card.
settings_alerts_labels.telegram_connect_help: You must connect your own Telegram account here before alerts or commands will work. Click Connect with Telegram, press Start in the bot chat, then click Check Connection.
settings_alerts_labels.telegram_connect_help_missing: Enter the bot token and username above, then save settings. After that, connect your Telegram account below.
settings_alerts_labels.telegram_connect_help_ready: Required step: click Connect with Telegram, press Start in the bot chat, then click Check Connection.
settings_alerts_labels.llm_copy: Used for fit decisions and CV extraction. The available models are managed in Global settings.
settings_alerts_labels.schedule_status_unavailable: Scheduler unavailable — automatic runs will not start.

search_source_labels_description: Display labels and helper copy for search source controls.

search_source_labels.section_copy: Choose which job boards Job Hunter searches.
search_source_labels.shared_inputs_copy: Shared search inputs that apply across all enabled sources.
search_source_labels.seek_toggle_help: Select if you want to include SEEK in search runs.
search_source_labels.linkedin_toggle_help: Select if you want to include LinkedIn in search runs.
search_source_labels.apsjobs_toggle_help: Select if you want to include Australian Public Service (APS) job listings in search runs.

check_item_labels_description: Full-sentence risk and warning copy shown in the 'Checks before applying' panel on job cards.

check_item_labels.clearance_requirement_warning: This job appears to require {clearance} clearance. Confirm your clearance level meets this requirement before applying.
check_item_labels.description_capture_issue: Description issue: full job description was not captured clearly.
check_item_labels.linkedin_freshness_unverified_warning: Freshness may be unreliable — LinkedIn can show a reposted date for external-apply listings, and the original posting date could not be verified.
check_item_labels.employer_outcome_history_template: Your history with $employer: rejected $rejections. Latest outcome $last_date.
check_item_labels.employer_outcome_unavailable: Could not check your history with this employer.

scoring_audit_labels_description: Labels for the debug-only scoring audit table and decision trace shown on job cards.
candidate_history_labels_description: Labels for the candidate application history panel on job cards. review_reason_prefix is debug-only.
profile_field_labels_description: Display labels and help text for profile/settings preference fields (engagement type, contract length, work mode, sector, salary, review-gating messages) sourced by job_hunter_agent/profile_store.py.

profile_field_labels.min_contract_month_help_text: Contracts shorter than this are excluded before scoring. Only applies when the listing states a duration explicitly.
profile_field_labels.work_mode_preference_help_text: Choose the work arrangements you prefer.
profile_field_labels.sector_preference_help_text: Select both if sector preference does not matter.
profile_field_labels.salary_min_compensation_help_text: Set the lowest pay you want included in search.
profile_field_labels.settings_salary_annual_help_text: Used when permanent roles list salary.
profile_field_labels.settings_salary_daily_help_text: Used when contract roles list a day rate.
profile_field_labels.profile_review_blocking_reason_no_profil: Create your profile before reviewing jobs.
profile_field_labels.profile_review_blocking_reason_no_capabi: Your profile has no capability rules. Rebuild onboarding before reviewing jobs.
profile_field_labels.search_keywords_length_error: Please keep the role preference between 2 and 120 characters.
profile_field_labels.search_keywords_phrase_error: Please use at least two words for the role preference, or leave it blank.
